'''Carg''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] who served within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Carg most served at an outpost on the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].
He commanded [[Graul Company]] during the third [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Third battle of Felucia|invasion]] of the planet.
